$comment: Provenance manifest — the SINGLE source of truth for whose words a passage is and what the tagging harness may generate for it. The harness gates ONLY from this file (provenance.py interprets it); there are no ad-hoc authorship rules in code. Mirrors the reviewed rules behind app/lib/12-provenance.ts and app/lib/15-transcript-speakers.ts, with one harness-side addition: speaker carry-forward across continuation paragraphs, which the app cannot do per-paragraph but an offline pass over a whole transcript can.
mixed_verify_policy: MIXED_VERIFY is treated exactly like NOT_HIS everywhere until verified from the book's own front matter.

books.$comment: Book-slug rules applied to verses (slug from chapters.book_slug, falling back to lower(verses.scripture)) and prose_paragraphs (book_slug column). his_slugs is the verified HIS registry (mirrors BOOK_REGISTRY in app/lib/12-provenance.ts); sb is HIS at book level with the per-passage completion rule below. Slugs not listed anywhere fall to 'unknown_book_slug' — never assume words are his without evidence.

sb_completion_rule.$comment: Srimad-Bhagavatam was completed by disciples from Canto 10 Chapter 14 onward (and all of Cantos 11-12). Canto+chapter are parsed from the verse's own vedabase_url; the chapters-table fields are the fallback. When neither parses to numbers the rule does not fire (the book-level ruling stands).

verse_chunks.$comment: Never sent to Gemini; tags_core is inherited from the parent verse by SQL.

transcripts.$comment: Lecture/conversation paragraphs are verbatim multi-speaker blocks with 'Name:' prefixes baked into body_text; many continuation paragraphs carry no prefix. The harness walks each transcript's paragraphs in paragraph_number order, segments on the prefix regex, and carries the LAST named speaker forward across prefix-less continuation paragraphs within that transcript. A paragraph counts as Prabhupada-speaking if he is among its speakers (his own prefix in the paragraph, or carried forward into an unprefixed continuation).
transcripts.regex_flavor: unicode (Python 'regex' module; \p{..} classes as in app/lib/15-transcript-speakers.ts SPEAKER_LINE_RE)
transcripts.name_folding: NFD, strip combining marks, lowercase, keep [a-z ] only, trim
transcripts.before_any_named_speaker_comment: Paragraphs before the first named prefix in a transcript have no evidenced speaker — ambiguous is not his.

gating.$comment: What the combined tagging call may generate per authorship. Questions are the doc2query lane: ONLY passages that are verifiably Prabhupada-speaking / HIS may carry them. NOT_HIS and MIXED_VERIFY rows get topic tags only — the responseSchema for those rows omits the questions field entirely, and the code gate drops any that appear anyway.
